done_when: Close starts the review at the same time as its tests, so a round takes about as long as the slower of the two; a red test or a P0/P1 finding still stops the round, and both results are reported together. New and existing client repos get it on init or upgrade plus sync, and a test covers both.

findings.body: Raise: Test. The required end-to-end test fails intermittently in the repository suite. Its 15-second socket timeout also covers preparation and review-lane admission; the proof list records three post-commit timeout failures and about 33 seconds before review-lane admission. Those failures do not show that close ran tests and review sequentially, but they leave the new-client and earlier-adoption cases without reliable suite proof. The direct diagnostic passes do not resolve the full-suite failure.
findings.title: Not done: tests/test_close_runs_tests_and_review_together.py::test_1_close_starts_tests_and_review_together_and_reports_both

why: Close waits for tests to finish before it starts the review
